newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE gilt future volume hits record on May 6.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE gilt future volume hits record on May 6.

text.p: Gilt futures traded on the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) set a new record volume on Tuesday, a spokesman for LIFFE said on Wednesday.
A total 236,433 lots traded, beating the previous record of 235,759 set on February 24, 1992.
On Tuesday, gilt futures posted the biggest one-day gain in five years after the new chancellor Gordon Brown granted the Bank of England operational independence, analysts said.
June gilt futures soared to a high of 113-24 on Tuesday, compared with a low of 111-02.
